require: хотя бы два сложных элемента: придаточное, причастный оборот, инверсия, cleft, эллипсис
связность через продвинутые linking words и discourse markers
чёткая стилистическая цель (эмфаза, дистанцирование, вежливость, критика)

patterns.generation_hint: Используй so/such inversion для эмфазы. Порядок: so + adj + aux + subject + that...
examples: So impressive was the strategic initiative that the board immediately approved a substantial budget increase.
So overwhelming was the response from stakeholders that the company decided to accelerate the entire rollout.
Such was the impact of the restructuring plan that the industry had to rethink its approach.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'Only when' для эмфазы условия. Инверсия в главной части.
examples: Only when the client had approved the proposal did the team realize how much work still lay ahead.
Only when we had fully understood the complexity of the situation did we appreciate the true scale of the challenge.
Only when the audit had been completed did the board acknowledge the extent of the problem.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй 'Hardly had... when' для двух быстро следующих событий.
examples: Hardly had she completed the certification when she was offered a significantly more challenging role.
Hardly had the team implemented the new system when the first signs of improvement became apparent.
Hardly had the board approved the plan when the market conditions changed dramatically.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй subjunctive после формальных глаголов требования и рекомендации.
examples: The board insists that the senior management team implement the strategic initiative without delay.
The committee recommends that the client's representative attend every high-stakes meeting, given the complexity of the situation.
She demanded that the stakeholders be informed immediately, because the decision could have far-reaching consequences.

patterns.pattern: [Long live / Come what may / Be that as it may / Suffice it to say] + [S] + [V1] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй формульный subjunctive для формальных и устойчивых выражений.

formula: Far be it from me to

examples: Suffice it to say that the strategic initiative has fundamentally transformed the way we operate.
Be that as it may, we must still prioritize long-term strategy over short-term gains.
Far be it from me to criticize the decision, but the underlying issues remain unresolved.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + had + [V3] + [complex object], [S] + would + [V1] + [complex object] + now
patterns.generation_hint: Смешанный conditional: условие в прошлом, результат в настоящем.
examples: If I had implemented the strategic initiative last year, I would be in a completely different position now.
If she had prioritized long-term strategy over short-term gains, she would manage a much more successful team today.
If they had anticipated the market shift, they would be leading the industry instead of playing catch-up.

patterns.pattern: If + [S] + were + [V-ing] + [complex object], [S] + would have + [V3] + [complex object]
patterns.generation_hint: Смешанный conditional: условие в настоящем, результат в прошлом.
examples: If she were more open to feedback, she would have handled the situation much more effectively last quarter.
If they were genuinely committed to innovation, they would have invested in the technology years ago.
If I were better at delegating, I would have avoided the burnout I experienced last year.

patterns.pattern: [It could be argued / It might be suggested / One could contend] + that + [S] + [V1] + [complex object] + [optional: reason]
patterns.generation_hint: Используй hedging для дистанцирования и вежливости в академическом и деловом стиле.
examples: It could be argued that the senior management team underestimated the complexity of the situation, given the recent developments.
It might be suggested that we prioritize long-term strategy over short-term gains, because the latter often proves unsustainable.
One could contend that the policy-makers responsible failed to anticipate the far-reaching consequences of their decision.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй nominalization для формального академического стиля.
examples: The implementation of the strategic initiative requires a comprehensive framework that aligns with our long-term objectives.
The coordination of cross-functional teams demands a level of trust that takes years to build.
The prioritization of long-term strategy over short-term gains often requires considerable courage from leadership.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй модальные перфекты для критики или сожаления о прошлом.
examples: The management should have informed the stakeholders before making such a decision, but transparency was clearly not a priority.
She could have anticipated the market shift, but she was too focused on short-term results.
They might have avoided the crisis altogether, but they ignored the early warning signs.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй needn't have + V3 для действий, которые были выполнены, но не были необходимы.
examples: I needn't have prepared such a comprehensive presentation, because the meeting was postponed at the last minute.
She needn't have implemented the entire system so quickly, because the deadline had been extended.
They needn't have orchestrated such a complex rollout, because the market was not ready for it.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй perfect participle для действия, завершённого до другого. Формальный стиль.
examples: Having orchestrated the entire strategic initiative, the team focused on developing a comprehensive framework for long-term growth.
Having reviewed all the applications, the committee recommended three candidates for the next stage.
Having coordinated the high-stakes negotiation, she decided to take on an even more challenging role.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй reduced relative clauses для сжатости формального стиля.
examples: The strategy orchestrating the entire transformation requires a level of coordination that few organizations can sustain.
The initiative spearheading the industry's shift towards sustainability demands considerable investment in new technology.
The framework facilitating cross-functional collaboration has fundamentally changed the way we approach projects.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй reversed wh-cleft для эмфазы. Фокус в начале.
examples: A comprehensive strategy is what we need, because the old approach is no longer sustainable.
Long-term commitment is what distinguishes successful companies from those that fade away.
Genuine collaboration is what makes a cross-functional team truly effective.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй it-cleft для выделения ключевого элемента.
examples: It was the strategic initiative that fundamentally transformed the way we approach our work.
It is her leadership that has inspired the whole team to achieve outstanding results.
It was their commitment that made the difference between failure and success.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй идиомы уровня C1 в естественном контексте.
examples: The team shed light on the underlying issues, and the whole approach had to be reconsidered.
She took stock of the situation before making any decisions, which proved to be remarkably wise.
They went the extra mile to ensure the project's success, and it certainly bore fruit in the end.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй устойчивые коллокации уровня C1.
examples: The board drew a clear distinction between short-term tactics and long-term strategy.
They reached a consensus on the comprehensive restructuring plan after lengthy discussions.
The consultant made a compelling case for investing in new technology, given the competitive landscape.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй продвинутые linking words для академического стиля.
examples: Our team has implemented a comprehensive strategic initiative. Nevertheless, we still need to address several long-term challenges.
The company invested heavily in new technology. Consequently, it developed innovative solutions that transformed the market.
She completed the certification in project management. Furthermore, she has developed a completely new training programme.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй дискурсивные маркеры для связности и естественности.
examples: To put it another way, the strategic initiative has fundamentally transformed the way we operate.
Strictly speaking, the results are preliminary and require further validation before any conclusions can be drawn.
All things considered, the decision was the right one, despite the short-term costs involved.

patterns.generation_hint: Используй эллипсис для сжатости и естественности в формальной речи.
examples: I can implement this strategy, and so can she.
We have completed the certification, and they have too.
She doesn't want to attend the conference, and neither do I.
